oo-design-1484864994371.notes: Runnable JavaScript companion. Uses classes, Fisher–Yates shuffle, and a set of possible ace totals; completes methods left as sketches in the source.
oo-design-1484864994371.complexity: Deal O(1); shuffle O(n) time and O(1) extra space. Blackjack possible totals O(n × (a + 1)) time and O(a + 1) space for n cards and a aces.

oo-design-1484865025096.notes: Runnable in-memory JavaScript companion. Routes the oldest eligible queued call to the lowest available rank; completion and escalation trigger redispatch. A real service needs durable state and concurrency control.
oo-design-1484865025096.complexity: Drain O(Q × E) for Q queued calls and E employees. O(Q + E) state; employee ranks are sorted once in O(E log E).

oo-design-1484865054751.notes: Runnable JavaScript companion matching the source constraints. Supports negative safe-integer keys; no resizing. Average lookup is O(1 + load factor), with O(n) worst-case collisions.
oo-design-1484865054751.complexity: Average O(1 + n / capacity) per operation; O(n) worst-case collision chains. O(n + capacity) storage.

oo-design-1484865075215.notes: Runnable JavaScript companion completing the source sketch. A Map plus sentinel-based doubly linked list gives expected O(1) get and set, with O(capacity) storage. get returns undefined on a miss; has distinguishes a stored undefined.
oo-design-1484865075215.complexity: Expected O(1) get/set/has with Map lookup and linked-list updates; O(capacity) storage.

oo-design-1486849877916.notes: Runnable JavaScript companion implementing the requested in-memory domain workflows. Authentication, persistence, message delivery, and distributed ordering are separate production concerns; IDs of actors here represent already authenticated users.
oo-design-1486849877916.complexity: Expected O(1) indexed user lookup, friendship operations, and message append. User removal O(users + chats); storage grows with users, friendships, memberships, and messages.

oo-design-1486853316037.notes: Runnable JavaScript companion. Vehicles own their allocated spots; the lot reserves a complete run before mutating it. A bus needs five adjacent large spots in one row on one level. Allocation is O(total spots).
oo-design-1486853316037.complexity: O(total spots) allocation and O(k) temporary run for a vehicle requiring k spots. Release O(k); availability count O(spots on level).
